Commentary.Commentary: West Indies once again will have themselves to blame as they didn't make the most of the chance to bowl out the opposition early. Bishoo and Nurse ran through the Rhodesians' batting line-up, picking up 3-fer apiece, but once their spell was over, the visitors lacked the venom and allowed the opposition to settle with some really poor, poor captaincy by Jason Holder. So, the home side would feel they have enough to play with and the pitch is really slow to be honest. Batting won't be that easy and Zimbabwe will bank on their spinners to do the job. We have seen a high scoring nail-biter, are we up for a low-scoring one? Join us in a short while to see who faces Sri Lanka in the final.

Sikandar Raza Butt, the tormentor-in-chief kept hold at one end and never for a moment felt the heat of running out of partners. Firstly, Donald Tiripano gave him a good company and threaded a 38-run stand but once the latter got out, Tendai Chisoro walked in and came to rescue his team from dire straits. He along with Raza got involved in an unbeaten stand of 91 runs - their highest 9th wicket stand in this format.

What a fightback from Zimbabwe, it's simply outstanding. After winning the toss and opting to bat under overcast conditions, the home side didn't get the start they would have liked. The drizzle got heavier and there was a mini delay. Once the game resumed, the West Indies came out all guns blazing and reduced the home side to 89/7. It seemed like things would wrap up quickly but the high-flying Caribbeans were brought down to earth.

Well done, ZIMBABWE! Fuller on off, Raza goes for the slog, gets it through mid-wicket off the inner half for a couple of runs. Hats off to Raza, he has done superbly to ensure Zimbabwe finish with a good score.
Spots the short fine leg fielder in, gets across to paddle it but misses.
FOUR! West Indies are looking clueless out here! Carlos sprays it wide outside off, Raza making room manages to get under it and spanks it wide over covers for a boundary.
Full outside off, smashed towards long off for a single.
SIX! More power to you, Chisoro! Bowls it outside off, Chisoro pulls it hard over square leg for another maximum. This is really good batting from him.
Fuller on middle, Raza backs away and squeezes it out towards point for a single.

NOT OUT! Waste of a review! Slower one outside off, Chisoro throws his bat at it but seems to have missed it. The keeper and bowler appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays confirm there was no bat there. Wonder what made Holder review.
A caught behind appeal is taken upstairs against Tendai Chisoro.

SIX! TAKE THAT, HOLDER! That should be how Zimbabwe have slapped West Indies hard! Holder dishes out a length ball outside off, Chisoro gets under it and pulls it high and handsome over backward square leg for a maximum.
Outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Dishes out a full toss outside off, Raza hits it down to long off for another brace.
Bowls a slower one outside off, Raza is early into his loft. The ball goes towards Carlos at long off who fumbles coming in and allows a second.
Goes round the wicket.
FOUR! CRASHED! Fuller outside off, Raza makes some room and crashes it through covers for a boundary.  That beat the fielder in the deep who was running to his right.
HOLDER returns for a bowl.
Angled on a fuller length on off, played through long on for a single.
Bowls the slower one outside off, Raza looks to chop it through but fails to put bat to ball.
Fuller on middle, Chisoro clips it nicely over mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single. That was off the inside half of the bat.
Fuller on off, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground for a single.

NOT OUT! Shorter outside off, Raza pulls it through mid-wicket for another brace. There is a direct hit at the bowlers' end by Holder in the deep and it is referred upstairs. The replays show that Chisoro had grounded his bat in time. They have run one short though.
A direct hit at the bowler's end is referred upstairs...
On the pads, clipped to short fine leg and a single is stolen. West Indies are really sitting back for some reason, than attacking.
Fuller outside off, Raza clips it through mid on for a single.
Shorter length outside off, Raza lets it go. The umpire signals it one for the over.
Fuller outside off, placed to deep cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, Chisoro carves it over covers for a couple of runs.
50-run stand between Raza and Chisoro!
WIDE! Sprays it way outside off for a wide. Two Chisoro's might not have been enough to play that one.
JONATHAN CARTER into the attack.
Fuller length outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller length on off, turned through mid-wicket for a single by Raza. West Indies are seriously lacking intent here.
Takes a single with a push through long on.
Outside off on a length, Raza gets a leading edge wide of mid off for a single.
Another impressive pull from Chisoro to this short one, a single taken to square leg.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off. The fielder in the deep, Charles fumbles and allows the second run.
WIDE! Slips one down the leg side for a wide. Some really stupid bowling from Carlos Brathwaite here.
CARLOS back on for a bowl.

NOT OUT! Well run! Attempts a yorker but bowls a full toss on middle, Raza clips it through mid-wicket. The fielder fires a throw at the non-striker's end. Holder collects the ball and whips the bails off as Chisoro completes the second. It is referred upstairs but replays confirm Chisoro was fine there.
A run out appeal against Chisoro is referred upstairs.
Back of a length on middle, Chisoro pulls it through square leg for a single. That was nicely done.
Shorter outside off, Chisoro looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto his body.
6th ODI fifty for Sikandar Raza!
FIFTY! Fuller length on off, Raza clips it towards mid on for a single and that brings up his fifty. Superb knock from Raza, good it be a match winning one? Let's see.
Similar length, placed behind point for a single. This is smart batting from Zimbabwe.
Shorter length on off, turned towards square leg for a leg bye as it went off the pads.

Fuller on off, driven straight to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller on middle, clipped towards backward square leg for one.

On the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, worked towards the leg side for a single.
On a length and outside off, SR taps in front of point and calls for a single. Chisoro completes it.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, pulled through square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Chisoro blocks it out.
On middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a single.
HOLDER comes back on.
On middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

No ball! Cummins slips a waist height full toss outside off, Raza arches back, hops and hits it through point for a single. No ball called for the height and Free-Hit coming up.
CUMMINS comes on for a bowl.
Another overpitched delivery on off, Raza drills it through covers and the good thing is that he will be on strike.
Overpitched on off, driven towards mid on for a single.

FOUR! Tickled away! Holder bowls a low full toss down the leg side, Tendai just needed to help it on its away and he does so with ease. Flicks it and it races down to fine leg for a boundary. Vital runs!

Fuller and angling in, Donald gets across and flicks it towards mid-wicket.

Another harmless ball outside off, punched towards covers from within the crease.

Fuller on middle, turned through the on side for a single.

Cut behind point for a single.
Covers the line and pushes it towards the on side.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Nurse gives this one a nice loop and bowls it around middle, it turns away a bit as Ervine tries to defend it by coming forward. He plays down the wrong line and the ball brushes the back pad. A loud appeal follows and the umpire rules it out. Ervine takes the review. Replays show the impact was in line and the ball would have gone on to hit the middle stumps. zimbabwe rocked after the rain break.
Ervine is adjudged LBW but he opts for the review straightaway.

OUT! Dragged on! Bishoo has another one! Bowls a flatter one around middle, it skids in after pitching. Chari tries to transfer his weight on the back foot as he winds up for the big heave across the line. Gets a thick inside edge that deflects on the stumps. Angles it on the pads, Ervine looks to flick it through the leg side but gets and insdie edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side.
Googly around middle, skidding in as well, Brian gets back in time and punches it towards covers. A maiden for Bishoo!
Pushed slower through the air around off, defended down watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball around off, Chari comes down the track to defend but misses as the ball lobs off the pads towards the vacant short leg area.
Chari prods forward and keeps it out.

Tossed up ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Short of a length ball on leg, Ervine looks to pull but misses as the ball doesn't bounce much and hits him on the hip bone. Craig is down on the ground and looks to be in some pain.
Angles in a length ball on the pads, defended by getting right behind it.
Yorker dished on off, Ervine digs it out in time towards the off side.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Length ball on the hips, tucked towards mid-wicket for a quick single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but no damage done.
Fuller on off, Ervine digs it out towards point.
Drops it short on middle, Ervine pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Gets behind the line and defends.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot nicely.

OUT! Yorked him! Lovely piece of bowling from Bishoo! He gets the very first over and provides his skipper with a wicket. Devendra bowls a loopy yorker on middle, Masakadza tries to drive it through the square of the wicket on the off side but is late to bring his bat down. The ball goes through and disturbs the woodwork behind.
Tossed up ball around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle, jammed out towards the leg side.
The players are out in the middle! Just an over lost then, it will be a 49-over per side game.
1440 IST - Good news folks! The covers are coming off. The rain has ceased and we should be starting soon.

1350 IST - The umpires finally decide that the rain is getting heavier and have asked the players to walk off. The groundsmen are running in with the covers and we are in for a delay here. Zimbabwe will have to win to make it through to the finals but West Indies won't be worrying, if no play happens, they will face the Lankans. Let's hope for the best. Stay with us for the updates.

FOUR! Boom! Fuller in length and served on off, Chari drills this one powerfully through covers for a boundary. No need to run for those.
Touch fuller in and around off, pushed towards covers.
Short of a length ball on off, Chari looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards the off side.
Hamilton Masakadza is the new man in, replacing Chibhabha.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Jason Holder, the leading wicket-taker in the series draws first blood. Hurls a full length ball which comes back in with the angle. Chibhabha plays down the wrong line and pays the price for the same. The ball goes through and rattles the furniture behind. Holder is up and running.
Outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat and glides it towards third man for a single.
Fuller in length delivery on off, Chari defends it off the front foot.
Flicked through the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! Back of a length ball, width on offer and Chibhabha jumps all over it. Stands tall and crunches it through cover-point for a boundary all the way.
Fuller in length on off, Chibhabha leans into it and drives it through covers. Two fielders give it a chase and keeps them down to a couple.
Angles it on middle and leg, clipped towards fine leg to keep strike.
Outside off, Chibhabha leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, CC looks to cut this through point but is beaten all ends up.
Good length ball on off, defended with a straight bat.

Bonus runs! This is not at all impressive. Angles in a length ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket and Chari sets off. Charles comes running in and fires a wild throw at the striker's end. The fielder at backward point fails to stop that one as he was to his right but the throw went past his left and runs down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Back of a length ball, nipping in sharply after hitting the deck. Chari is surprised by the bounce and gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
Good length delivery in the channel on off, double C makes another easy leave to the keeper.
Angles in a length ball, nips back in a touch as Chibhabha decides to leave it alone.
Landed around off, Chari opens the face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
On a good length and pitched around off, Chari leaves it alone.
On a length and outside off, stays a bit low as well. Chibhabha cuts it through point for a single to get off the mark.
Jason Holder to share the second new ball from the other end.
Beaten! Cummins is making him play at it. Once again bowls a length ball on off, Chari feels for it and as a result tries to cut this one only to be beaten. A decent first over.
Too full and wide outside off, Chari lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Wide! Short of a length delivery outside off, BC looks to slash it through the line but fails to get any bat on it. Doesn't need to play at those very early in this game.
Touch fuller and around off, Brain pushes it towards covers, looks for a single but won't get it.
Wide! Good length served wide outside off, Chari has got nothing to do with that one.
On a length and moves away after pitching, Brian shoulders his arms to that one.
Cummins starts off with a full length delivery in the channel on off, Chari makes an easy leave to the keeper.

We are all set to get underway. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. Brian Chari and Chamu Chibhabha are the Zimbabwe openers. West Indies begin with Miguel Cummins who has two slips in place. Let's go...

Pat Symcox doing the pitch report says it is changing in each game. Adds in the last game it was a bit slow. Further says this one is really dry and there is not much grass and it will only get slower and lower. Runs will be tough to come by. Ends by saying there will be early swing with the cloud cover.

JASON HOLDER feels even he wanted to bat. But says the conditions are good for bowling as well so not much to do with the toss. Is really disappointed with how things have gone so far and will look to start fresh now in this crucial game.
GRAEME CREMER says they will bat first. Feels his team hasn't played up to its potential and will look to come out with a bang today.

Team changes for West Indies - They have made a couple of changes DEVENDRA BISHOO and MIGUEL CUMMINS come in for Sulieman Benn and injured Shannon Gabriel. Just one change for the home side as HAMILTON MASAKADZA replaces Elton Chigumbura.
TOSS - Cremer spins the coin. Holder calls it incorrectly. ZIMBABWE WILL BAT!

West Indies despite being the most dominating team has failed to make their mark and are finding themselves in a must-win scenario today. We have reached at that stage where either teams can't afford to put their foot wrong. Who will be in the finals to face the mighty Lankans? Stay tuned as the all-important toss is coming your way.

The tri-series have reached its final stage and it's all to play for now. Zimbabwe are still in the hunt to make it through as they got those 4 crucial points, one where they eked out a tie and then the rain gods came to the rescue. Cremer's men will feel they can take this to their advantage and need another great performance today.
